class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

def distributeCandy(root):
    def dfs(node):
        if not node:
            return 0, 0
        
        left_moves, left_excess = dfs(node.left)
        right_moves, right_excess = dfs(node.right)
        
        total_excess = node.val + left_excess + right_excess - 1
        moves = abs(left_excess) + abs(right_excess) + left_moves + right_moves
        
        return moves, total_excess
    
    moves, _ = dfs(root)
    return moves
